acceptedDependencyRule: Accepted plans are not redispatched, re-implemented or edited. Their files are read-only for every run-3 plan unless listed in that plan's writePaths.

sharedFileOwnership.rule: design-v1-3-sentry-parity.md section 15 'Run 3' notes: each wave holds one plan and waves run serially, so no two plans share a file; each plan owns every shared file its change can break. Workers run in the same working directory and do not commit; a later wave sees the earlier wave's uncommitted changes, so diff guards exclude the earlier plan's paths.
sharedFileOwnership.routeWalk: p12 owns tests/e2e/test_route_permissions.py, tests/e2e/test_api_routes.py and the new test_wiring_v13.py and test_route_permissions_v13.py. Composition copies APIRoute objects (src/telescreen/api/routers/issues.py:build_issues_router) or registers whole routers in container.routers; never include_router in wiring code (FastAPI 0.142 lazy _IncludedRouter). tests/api/v12_rbac/** is read-only (its inventory filters to a fixed MODULES tuple).
sharedFileOwnership.inventoryTests: No run-3 plan adds a table, migration, template, event kind or example: tests/db/test_models.py, tests/notifications/**, tests/examples/** and the existing tests/leak files are read-only. p17 adds only new tests/leak v13 files.
sharedFileOwnership.frontend: p17 is the only run-3 screenshot runner and the only editor of src/web/scripts/screenshots.ts (strict-run selector fixes only). src/web/src/** is read-only for all run-3 plans.
sharedFileOwnership.docs: p17 owns README.md, impl-plans/README.md and the v1.3 status lines of the six design docs during wave C; the finalization then edits impl-plans/README.md serially.

issueReference.title: Telescreen v1.3: Sentry parity for UI and features (self-review follow-up)
issueReference.designAcceptance: Design accepted in session 11; revised in sessions 12-13; session 14 Step 2 (comm-000686 intake) revised section 15 (run-3 notes, finalization) and section 16 (live dev-stack command), accepted by Step 3 (comm-000688).
issueReference.planAcceptance: Session 14 Step 5 impl-plan review accepted p07, p12, p17 and this manifest (comm-000690).

reviewContext.userProblem: The owner asked (translated): 'Self-review the UI and the features. Are we providing the same usability and functionality as Sentry? If not, improve it.' The committed self-review found 7 defects (B1-B7) and a 60-item Sentry gap table; the adopted scope is S0-S10. Runs 1-2 delivered 14 plans; run 3 re-verifies p07, wires every v1.3 port and router (p12), adds the leak/E2E/live/screenshot verification and docs (p17) and finalizes.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Run 3 waves hold one plan each and run serially (design section 15 'Run 3'), so no two plans share a file and each plan owns every shared file its change can break.
p07 is re-verified, not re-implemented: its code is complete at ca818c3 and it was blocked only by the progress gate (conventions 7a).

p12 composes routers by copying APIRoute objects or registering whole routers in container.routers; never include_router, because FastAPI 0.142 keeps lazy _IncludedRouter entries the route-permission walk cannot see.
p12 registers every v1.3 router before the issues router so GET /api/issues/counts is not captured by GET /api/issues/{issue_id}; a test guards the order.
IssueEventFanout calls workflow triggers then AlertEvaluator in the same session; DeferredIssueEventSink.target is widened accordingly.
p17 is the only run-3 screenshot runner and editor of src/web/scripts/screenshots.ts; live tests sit under tests/live/v13, marked live and skipped offline.
intentionalTradeoffs: Serial single-plan waves trade parallelism for zero shared-file conflict in the final run.
p12 may edit tests/e2e/test_route_permissions.py only if registration breaks the walk, never weakening the one-marker rule; v13 routes are checked in a new test_route_permissions_v13.py.
Live checks are owner-only; a skipped live test is reported as 'not run' with the missing variable names, never as a pass.
Design docs get status wording only in p17; factual fixes only when a code mismatch is found and recorded.
supportedEdgeCases: GET /api/issues/counts returns counts, not a 404/422 from the issue_id route.

Comment-edit mentions keep the member notifier: issue_events and issue_activity routers reuse the same IssuesRouterDeps instance as build_issues_router (review residual risk, checked by test_wiring_v13 and E3).
E1-E5 offline including merge into an archived primary (safety rule 5: never escalates, never changes archive_until).
Leak flows 1-9 assert database_text, logs, search_documents, outbound_bodies and api_responses carry no raw sample value.
Strict screenshots fail on any state-skipped line or browser error in light and dark.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Deferred product areas: releases, environments, projects, Discover, Jira create, replay, performance and profiling.
Live runs against real Keycloak, Mailpit or Slack in default CI (owner-only, TELESCREEN_TEST_* variables).
UsersRouterDeps changes (review residual risk: it gains no new field; only DirectoryRouterDeps.member_admin is new).
requiredOutcomes: Wave A: p07 re-verified green with a step result that passes the progress gate (conventions 7a).

Wave B: every v1.3 port and router bound in build_container; every route declares exactly one permission; the route walk and the v13 route table pass; GET /api/issues/counts is not captured by /api/issues/{issue_id}.

Wave C: leak flows 1-9 and E1-E5 pass offline; live tests exist, marked live, skipped offline; strict screenshots with no state-skipped line and 0 browser errors in light and dark; README v1.3 features, plan index and design status lines updated.
Final gates: mise run ci passes offline (baseline 988 passed / 8 skipped grows with the new tests, 0 failed); src/web typecheck, vitest (baseline 235 passed), build and screenshots pass.
nonGoals: Deferred by the accepted review: releases, environments, projects, Discover, Jira create, replay/performance/profiling.
No redispatch of accepted plans; no dependency change; no Alembic revision; no change to tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH or ty strictness; no per-file-ignore entries.
constraints: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: English only, no emojis; plan files under 400 lines; every Python file under 1000 lines.
Strict typing; masking contract (raw detected values never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned).
Default uv run pytest passes offline; live tests skip offline and a skipped live test is reported as 'not run'.

Conventions 2, 7 and 7a: write only inside writePaths; per-edit fresh read and pre/post SHA-256 in the Progress Log; fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands.
Workers never run git checkout/restore/stash/reset/clean/commit/add/push; only the serial finalization commits and pushes.
